title: Late Fees After a Returned Payment: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Training Note
content:
**Rule.** On a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement, where the period's latest payment was dated within the period's grace days and the bank later returned it, the late fee carries a returned-payment share:

- when that return is the **only** payment the bank has returned on the agreement for insufficient funds or a closed account in the 12 months up to the handling date, the tenant pays **50 percent** of the late fee;
- when the bank has returned **two or more** payments on the agreement in those 12 months, the tenant pays **70 percent**;
- a period whose latest payment was not returned, or was made after the grace days, carries no returned-payment share.

The share multiplies the late fee figured by the percentage on its basis, before that amount is rounded to the cent and compared with the late-fee floor.

## What the records show

- **Within the grace days:** the latest payment entry is dated on the period's due date or on any day up to and including the last grace day.
- **Later returned:** a payment reversal entry on the ledger dated on or after that payment.
- **Bank returns counted:** payment reversals on the agreement with the reason insufficient funds or account closed, dated in the 12 months up to the handling date; a card chargeback is not such a return.

## Combinations

| Latest payment within grace days | Returned by the bank afterwards | Bank returns in 12 months | Share paid |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 1 | 50% |
| yes | yes | 2 or more | 70% |
| yes | no | — | no share (full fee) |
| no, made after the grace days | yes or no | — | no share (full fee) |

## Training questions (hypothetical)

- *Rent due 1 June, 5 grace days; payment dated 4 June returned for insufficient funds on 9 June, no other return in the year.* The tenant pays 50 percent of the late fee.
- *Same, but an earlier payment was returned for a closed account in March of the same 12 months.* The tenant pays 70 percent.
- *Payment dated 8 June, returned later.* It was made after the grace days, so no returned-payment share applies.
